qualification.scope: non-Suspense, no timeout/delay UI, no custom loader retry; valid component function

note: Source-rooted adaptation of Vue PR14911 intermediate/final revisions. An old instance unmounts, its loader rejects, then a new instance reuses the definition. The shared rejected request must be cleared before the per-instance error callback is skipped. The original base retries through onError, although it has a separate pre-existing after-unmount notification. Same source baseline and host for both members; only the shared-cache reset differs between postimages.
